ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the Minneapolis shooting incident, including potential misconduct by federal officers and the response by local authorities.
questions: What was the justification for the use of force?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential misconduct by federal officers and shed light on issues of police accountability.

ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of corruption and abuse of power within Minnesota government.
